description: Standard purchase order issued by a buyer to a vendor specifying goods or services to be procured, delivery requirements, pricing, and payment terms.

sku.instruction: Stock keeping unit or part number identifying the product

description.instruction: Full description of the product or service for this line

quantity.instruction: Number of units ordered for this line item

unit_price.instruction: Price per single unit in the PO currency

line_total.instruction: Extended line total (quantity multiplied by unit price)

po_number.instruction: Buyer-assigned purchase order number, typically labeled 'PO Number' or 'Purchase Order #' in the document header

issue_date.instruction: Date the purchase order was issued, in ISO 8601 format if possible (e.g. 2024-05-15)

requested_delivery_date.instruction: Date by which the buyer requires delivery of the ordered goods or services, in ISO 8601 format if possible

buyer_org_name.instruction: Legal name of the buying organization, typically shown in the document header or 'Bill From' / 'Buyer' section

buyer_org_address.instruction: Full mailing address of the buying organization including street, city, state, and ZIP/postal code

ship_to_name.instruction: Name or department to which goods should be shipped, found in the 'Ship To' section

ship_to_address.instruction: Full delivery address including street, city, state, and ZIP/postal code from the 'Ship To' section

vendor_name.instruction: Legal name of the vendor or supplier receiving the purchase order

vendor_address.instruction: Full mailing address of the vendor including street, city, state, and ZIP/postal code

vendor_contact.instruction: Vendor contact person name, phone, or email if listed on the PO

payment_terms.instruction: Payment terms as stated on the PO (e.g. Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30)

currency.instruction: Three-letter ISO currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP). Infer from currency symbols if not explicitly stated.

subtotal.instruction: Sum of all line item totals before tax, labeled 'Subtotal' near the bottom of the PO

tax_amount.instruction: Total tax amount applied to the order, labeled 'Tax', 'Sales Tax', or 'VAT' near the order totals

order_total.instruction: Final total amount of the purchase order including subtotal and tax, typically labeled 'Total' or 'Order Total'

authorized_signer_name.instruction: Printed name of the authorized buyer representative who signed or approved the PO, found near the signature block

authorized_signer_title.instruction: Job title of the authorized signer as printed near the signature block

line_items.instruction: All product or service line items listed in the purchase order table
